end.summary:
Practised showing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi identified loose sticks in examples but counted the bundle as one item.
The bundle-as-ten mix-up appeared in turns 3–6 and was not corrected by the final turn.
Teach-back was not completed; lesson ended when Saanvi said they wanted to play.
end.parentNote: Asha practised numbers 11–20 with a bundle of ten and loose sticks. Saanvi worked with examples such as one bundle and three loose sticks, but continued counting the bundle as one item rather than ten; this was not yet corrected by the end. At home, build a bundle of 10 small objects and add 1–9 loose objects, then say the total together.
